stem: A candidate scores above 80 on every practical except Practical C, where the score is 76 with no critical error. Is the integrated lab complete?
choices: Yes, average all practical scores together.
Yes, if the capstone is above 90.
No; Practical C must be remediated and passed because required stations are non-compensatory.
Yes, because there was no critical error.
rationale: Each practical is required evidence with its own minimum standard; higher scores elsewhere cannot compensate for a failed required station.
